title: kitchen._on_sales_order_voided
description: Payload of the `sales.order.voided` event (contract of the sales module, SALES-F18): an OPEN check was deleted before being charged, so its rounds still on the line are cancelled (kitchen#162). The event is also emitted on a void that changed nothing (a check already charged from another device): the handler acts on the check's header (`reads` of `sales.order.get`), never on the event alone. additionalProperties=true on purpose: the relay delivers the emitter's payload AS IS, `sender` included (kitchen#29). Idempotent: a redelivery only sees cancelled rounds and writes nothing.
